summary_paragraph: The patient was admitted electively to transition from hemodialysis to peritoneal dialysis. She underwent an uncomplicated laparoscopic placement of a Tenckhoff peritoneal dialysis catheter. Postoperatively, she experienced minor oozing from the catheter site that resolved with pressure, and transient oxygen desaturation that improved with encouragement to deep breathe and supplemental oxygen, which was weaned off by the next day. She tolerated her scheduled hemodialysis session well and remained stable throughout her stay. She was discharged home with instructions to follow up with her nephrologist and PD nurse, continue all home medications, and monitor for signs of infection or complications at the catheter site.
